name: 複数アカウントのスペース切替シート
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0019 複数アカウントのスペース切替シート.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE two-account workspace-switch sheet, original region8,400,374,430 normalized. Exact Japanese content: centered title アカウント; section 個人のアカウント with two workspace rows (avatar灯, ライトハウスのスペース / 標準プラン; avatar学, 学びのスペース / 無料プラン); section 共同のアカウント with ONE row ライトハウスのスペース / 標準プラン, selected with check at right; bottom action 別のアカウントを追加. Top small neutral drag handle. Title Meiryo Bold14/24; names/action REGULAR40014/24; section/metadata REGULAR40012/16, tracking0. ORIGINAL controls source fine details: each account-section header has small horizontal three-dot menu at right (mock omitted both), bottom add action has plus INSIDE a circle (mock omitted it), selected third workspace uses ORIGINAL tiny colored house-emoji avatar artwork (brown roof, pale walls, blue windows, green base) instead of mock's substituted灯 tile. Preserve that actual original house artwork and colors, do not redesign into a new house logo or recolor green. First two authored Japanese initials remain white outlined avatar tiles with slate initials, no mint. No notification badges exist in THIS source; add none. Checkmark for third row forest green, all other utility glyphs slate. White rounded sheet and two white grouped surfaces with fine neutral outlines/soft shadows; pure-white outer canvas. Compact purposeful vertical grouping, preserve two accounts/three workspaces. No logout, create-workspace, source emails, background page or phone chrome. Uniform enlarged readable portrait around1200x1500, restrained white margins.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Preserve original house artwork colors. Selected third-row check adapts forest green; utility glyphs slate. Do not invent red badges from previous related component or mint avatar fills.
reviewNotes: 原版houseavatar/両ellipsis/丸plusを復元し3workspaceとthirdselectedを確認。house元色を保持する候補、pixel同一性未検証。要修正:section/name/action文字がRegularより太い、avatarがgrayfillでwhiteoutline指定からずれ。状態/内容は保持してweightと面を対象修正。操作/native/所有者承認なし。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
